claim.quote: In this paper a general description of the experimental set-up, overall performance of the detector, and first results are presented.

key_value_text.locator: arXiv:astro-ph/0404311, Section 4.1 'Exclusion plots' (PDF); not in the abstract
key_value_text.note: Corrected 2026-10-28: the locator used to say 'abstract', but the abstract only says that first results are presented. The paper draws the exclusion in Fig. 12 and adds, in Section 5, that 'the excluded region in Fig. 12 lies above those of other experiments' because of its relatively high background.
key_value_text.quote: The region above the curve is excluded at a 90% confidence level.
key_value_text.value: Spin-independent neutralino-nucleon cross sections above the curve of Fig. 12 are excluded at a 90% confidence level.

name: First results with the ORPHEUS dark matter detector

summary.plain: The first physics paper from ORPHEUS: it describes the detector and its performance and reports first results from the 2002 and 2003 runs, including a spin-independent exclusion plot.
summary.technical: 0.45 kg of Sn granules at 70 m.w.e.; Sec. 4.1 compares the single-flip rate (exposure 6.69e-3 kg d at the lowest threshold) with the expected spin-independent neutralino rate to draw a 90% C.L. exclusion plot; the paper notes it lies above other experiments' because of the relatively high background.

title: First results with the ORPHEUS dark matter detector
why_it_matters: The paper ends with projected exclusion plots for a background of 1 count kg-1 d-1, which it says would be attainable at a deeper underground site and with better shielding.
